    - paragraph: CC-860 UI verification — 21 Sep 2026 (copy) (copy) — Concept note
    - paragraph: 1 · Identification of the applicant
    - paragraph: Needs review
    - paragraph: 8 open gaps
    - paragraph: This application is being prepared for the European City Facility (EUCF) Call 7, funded by the European Union LIFE Programme. The applicant information below should identify the local authority or eligible public entity responsible for the proposed sustainable-energy investment concept.
    - heading "Applicant identity and contacts" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Applicant legal name:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the legal name of the applicant local authority or eligible public entity for the EUCF Call 7 application."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Applicant type:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Confirm the applicant type for the EUCF Call 7 application, including whether it is a local authority, grouping of local authorities, or aggregating local public entity."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Registered address and contact details:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the applicant''s registered address, official email address and telephone number for the EUCF Call 7 application."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Contact person(s):"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the name, role, email address and telephone number of each authorised contact person for the EUCF Call 7 application."'
    - heading "Administrative and territorial codes" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "LAU and NUTS 3 codes:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the LAU code and NUTS 3 code for the applicant territory, or the applicable Ukrainian territorial codes if the applicant is located in Ukraine."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Grouping arrangements:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Confirm whether the EUCF Call 7 applicant is a grouping of local authorities; if so, provide the lead applicant and the administrative codes for every participating authority."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Tax identification:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Confirm whether the EUCF Call 7 applicant is an aggregating local public entity; if so, provide its tax identification number or equivalent."'
    - heading "Population" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Total population:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the total population as an absolute number for the territory or territories represented by the EUCF Call 7 applicant, and specify the reference year."'
    - paragraph: 2 · Political commitments
    - paragraph: Needs review
    - paragraph: 7 open gaps
    - paragraph: The EUCF Call 7 application must demonstrate that the proposed sustainable-energy investment concept is grounded in an adopted local climate or energy planning framework and supported at the appropriate political level.
    - heading "Local climate or energy plan" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Upload the SECAP or other local climate or energy plan that covers the territory represented by the EUCF Call 7 applicant."'
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Plan title:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the title of the SECAP or other local climate or energy plan submitted for the territory represented by the EUCF Call 7 applicant."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Covered period:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the start and end years covered by the SECAP or other local climate or energy plan submitted for the EUCF Call 7 applicant."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Plan description:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide a concise description of the submitted local climate or energy plan, including how it supports sustainable-energy investment planning for the EUCF Call 7 applicant territory."'
    - heading "Mitigation target" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Provide at least one mitigation target from the submitted local climate or energy plan for the EUCF Call 7 applicant territory, including its value, unit, target year and the source-page number in the plan."'
    - heading "Political support" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Provide the political-support letter for the EUCF Call 7 application, signed by the Mayor or another relevant political representative using the mandatory EUCF template."'
    - heading "Previous EUCF support" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Confirm whether the EUCF Call 7 applicant has previously benefited from EUCF support, and provide the confirmation required for the application."'
    - paragraph: 3 · Proposed investment project
    - paragraph: Needs review
    - paragraph: 9 open gaps
    - paragraph: The proposed investment concept should define a sustainable-energy investment for which the applicant seeks EUCF support to prepare an investment concept. EUCF Call 7 support is intended for preparatory work and does not finance the underlying investment directly.
    - heading "Investment-concept title and rationale" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Proposed investment-concept title:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the title of the sustainable-energy investment concept to be developed by the EUCF Call 7 applicant."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Project description, local relevance and objectives:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Describe the proposed sustainable-energy investment project for the EUCF Call 7 applicant territory, including the local challenge it addresses, its scope and its specific objectives."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Foreseen implementation period:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the foreseen implementation period in months for the proposed sustainable-energy investment project in the EUCF Call 7 application."'
      - listitem:
        - text: "Main investment sector:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Identify the main investment sector for the proposed sustainable-energy investment project in the EUCF Call 7 application."'
    - heading "Delivery and governance" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Describe the governance structure for developing and delivering the proposed sustainable-energy investment project, including responsible organisations or departments, roles, decision-making arrangements, available internal capacity and any external-expert needs."'
    - heading "Stakeholder engagement" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Provide the stakeholder-engagement strategy for the proposed sustainable-energy investment project, including stakeholders, engagement activities, communication tools, timing and intended objectives."'
    - heading "Intended measures, costs and impacts" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: List each intended measure within the proposed sustainable-energy investment project, stating its sector, estimated CAPEX, and expected energy, renewable-energy and greenhouse-gas impacts."'
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: "Total expected sustainable-energy investment size:"
        - 'button "Information needed: Provide the total expected sustainable-energy investment size in EUR for the proposed project, including the basis or assumptions used to calculate the estimate."'
    - heading "Replication and upscaling" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Describe the potential to replicate or upscale the proposed sustainable-energy investment project within the EUCF Call 7 applicant territory or in other relevant territories."'
    - paragraph: 4 · Use of EUCF support
    - paragraph: Needs review
    - paragraph: 1 open gap
    - paragraph: EUCF Call 7 support is intended to develop the investment concept for the proposed sustainable-energy investment project; it does not finance the underlying investment. The fixed lump-sum grant may support preparatory work needed to make the project investment-ready, including relevant feasibility, engineering, legal, social, market, financial, energy-audit, capacity-building or technical-support activities.
    - heading "Activities requiring EUCF support" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - 'button "Information needed: Specify the preparatory activities for which the EUCF Call 7 grant is requested to develop the proposed sustainable-energy investment concept, identifying which activities will be undertaken internally and which require external expertise, and confirm whether this EUCF Call 7 application was prepared internally or with support from an external expert."'
    - paragraph: The requested activities should be directly linked to resolving the technical, financial, legal, market, organisational or other preparation needs that must be addressed before the proposed investment can proceed to implementation or financing.
    - heading "Preparation approach" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The applicant should identify the internal teams or capacities that will lead the investment-concept preparation and define the scope of any external expertise required. This approach should demonstrate that EUCF support will be used for clearly defined preparatory work and will strengthen the applicant's readiness to advance the proposed investment project.
